long_biography.plain_text:
Delmar Marine Transport's offices in Suez, Port Said and Alexandria place Ahmed Hassan Aly Kambouris at the centre of a broad Egyptian port-services operation. The company names him as general manager, while a business directory identifies the same owner under the transliteration Ahmed Hassan Ali Kambores at its Port Tawfik address.

The business began with customs clearance and ship-agency work in 1981, later extending its coverage to Egypt's principal ports. Its projects have combined canal transit, offshore logistics, crew support, permits and vessel chartering. Delmar says it became a shipowner and manager of three commercial vessels in 2003. Its listed fleet comprised the utility boat Delmar 1, the anchor-handling tug Ecolfiumicino and the research vessel OTS Yeoman.
